concerns.text: Participant entity defines attribute `stimulus_condition` but the plan (see plan.md, FR‑001/FR‑006 mapping) and the dataset contract use `stimulus_type`. Align the attribute name across data‑model, plan, and schema.

MMSE attribute is named `MMSE` in the data‑model, while the dataset schema (`contracts/dataset.schema.yaml`) calls it `mmse_score` and the plan references `MMSE`. Standardize the field name to avoid mismatched validation.

The data‑model defines a separate `WCSTMetric` entity, yet the plan never references this entity and operates directly on the cleaned CSV. Either incorporate the `WCSTMetric` entity into the pipeline description or remove it from the data‑model for consistency.
